text: よさげな　ポケモン　もって　ふらふら　あるいとる　おまえは　わすれて　おらんぞ

structure.jp: よさげな　ポケモン　もって
ふらふら　あるいとる　おまえは
わすれて　おらんぞ

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: よさげな　ポケモン　もって　ふらふら　あるいとる　おまえ
patterns.explanation: Everything before おまえ describes 'you', like 'you, who are ...'. よさげな　ポケモン　もって　ふらふら　あるいとる　おまえ = 'you, who wander around carrying good-looking Pokémon'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とる is an old-man and dialect squeezing of ておる, which is ている: something is going on. The same thing is in わすれて　おらん, 'have not forgotten'. あるいとる = 'are walking around'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to push a statement at the listener. わすれて　おらんぞ = 'I haven't forgotten, I tell you!'.
